purpose: Isolate exact global-cache representation after selection of the five-memory recurrent/global sequence backbone.
causal_question: Can each of five independent exact global memories be compressed from GQA3 to MQA1 or a 128-dimensional NoPE latent without losing language, retrieval, or composition quality, while reducing realized serving state and decode cost?

evidence_basis.use: MLA is exact global attention with a compressed per-token KV latent; published headline ratios are not imported as Speck measurements
sharing memories across attention positions reduces state but fails the route edge; this study therefore retains five independent memories
MQA is expressible, MLA is not implemented, and quality/kernel risks remain unmeasured locally

launch_blockers: the current six-cell whole-architecture proxy must pass its frozen disposition
the five-cache KDA/GQA sequence backbone must pass the separately frozen proxy-finalist replication required by the ordered sequence program
MLA reference and optimized paths must pass every correctness/export gate before any MLA language-model training
the comparison analysis, multiplicity correction, data cells, and realized systems protocol must be frozen before results
all run-specific storage and hardware gates must pass

fixed_backbone.position_rule: NoPE remains fixed; do not introduce a decoupled RoPE path in this isolation

arms.implementation: existing Attention with num_key_value_heads=1 and enable_gqa
arms.matching_reason: adding 21 uniformly to every SwiGLU width is closer than adding 22 and remains below the frozen 0.025% parameter tolerance

arms.dimension_reason: 128 latent elements match MQA1's BF16 state while 768x128 plus two 128x768 KV projections match GQA3's existing K/V projection weights; this isolates representation rather than choosing a published ratio
arms.normalization: one 128-dimensional latent RMSNorm replaces the existing 64-dimensional key RMSNorm; exact parameter and FLOP counts must be regenerated from code
arms.reference_path: expand per-head keys and values from the cached latent before ordinary exact attention
arms.optimized_path: absorb key up-projections into queries and value up-projections into the output path without materializing expanded cached K/V
arms.kernel_requirement: reference and optimized prefill/decode paths must agree before systems measurements

matching.multiplicity: Holm-correct both confirmation candidates against the shared GQA3 control
identical_within_cell: five attention positions and five independent memories
KDA layers, residual path, and NoPE
not_matched_away: projection and specialized-kernel work intrinsic to the representation

mqa1: checkpoint and Transformers export round trip
state bytes at every declared length and dtype
nope_mla128: checkpoint and Transformers export round trip
no expanded K/V tensors retained in optimized decode state
exact state, temporary workspace, and FLOP accounting

evidence_stages.discovery: three paired seed/data cells at the frozen proxy budget; no promotion authority
evidence_stages.finalist: three seeds crossed with two data orders and at least ten training tokens per larger parameter; promotion authority only if every policy endpoint passes

metrics: time and energy to locked quality

quality_endpoints: symbolic composition v2 with both constituent edges qualified
independent long-context suites only when their existing gates qualify

decision.rule: Among candidates passing correctness, all quality constraints, and their representation-specific realized systems threshold, choose the cheapest non-dominated cache representation; otherwise retain GQA3.
